description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lantern of Insight.
Cast Lantern of Insight from your graveyard by paying {0} due to The Vision and Scarlet Witch
Mirran Spy and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger
Resolve the Mirran Spy trigger, untapping Emry.
Resolve the The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Lantern of Insight by tapping and sacrificing it, causing target player to shuffle their library.
Repeat.
